blocks.title: Beats
blocks.text: Jab thori mukhtalif frequencies wali, ek hi simt mein chalti do waves ek doosre par charhti hain to awaz mein zyada se zyada aur kam se kam bulandi ke darmiyan wafqe wafqe (periodic) tabdeeli hoti hai, jise beats kehte hain.

Tuning forks khalis notes (ek hi frequency) dete hain. Agar ek hi frequency, maslan 32 Hz, ke do tuning forks A aur B alag alag bajaye jayein to khalis notes dete hain; ek saath bajane par ek fork ka note doosre se alag pehchanna mushkil hai, kyunke un ki sound waves superpose ho kar ek khalis note sunai deti hain. Agar fork B par thora mom (wax) ya plasticine laga diya jaye to us ki frequency thori kam ho jati hai, maslan 28 Hz; ab dono forks ek saath bajane par baari baari barhti aur ghatti shiddat ka note sunai deta hai. Is note ko beat note, ya beat, kehte hain, aur yeh forks A aur B ki sound waves ke interference se hai.

Fig. 7.12(a) fork A ke note ka waveform, Fig. 7.12(b) fork B ka, aur Fig. 7.12(c) dono ke ek saath bajne par nateeja dikhati hai; yeh batati hai ke beat note kaise banta hai. Kisi lamhe X par dono waves ke displacements ek hi simt mein hain, nateeja displacement bara hai aur buland awaz sunai deti hai. 1/8 s baad ek fork ka displacement doosre ke ulat hai, Y par kam se kam displacement, to dheemi ya koi awaz nahi; mazeed 1/8 s baad displacements phir ek simt mein aur Z par buland awaz.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke sath teen lehrein oopar neeche. (a) fork A ki lehar, (b) fork B ki thori lambi lehar, (c) dono ka nateeja, jis ka size dashed ghere ke andar barhta ghatta hai. Teeno par dashed lakeeren X (oonchi), Y (dheemi) aur Z (oonchi); X se Y aur Y se Z 1/8 s, aur X se Z 1/4 s. Resultant wave likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.12: Beats ka banna (kitab ki Figure 7.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A ki frequency 32 Hz aur B ki 28 Hz hai. X par dono crest ek sath: oonchi awaz. 1/8 s baad (Y) A ek crest aage nikal kar aadha chakkar farq bana leta hai, to dono ek doosre ko khatam karti hain: dheemi awaz. 1/4 s par (Z) phir oonchi. Yani har 1/4 s mein ek beat, fi second 4 beats = 32 - 28. Kitab ka text Y ko X se '1/4 s baad' aur Z ko Y se 'mazeed 1/4 s baad' likhta hai. 4 beats fi second ke saath ek buland awaz se agli tak 1/4 s hai, is liye buland se dheemi tak sirf 1/8 s hai, jaisa figure bhi dikhati hai.

Chunke dono forks ki frequencies ka farq bhi 4 Hz hai, fi second beats ki tadaad tuning forks ki frequencies ke farq ke barabar hai: fA = 32 Hz, fB = 28 Hz, fA bara fB se, beats ki tadaad = fA - fB = 32 Hz - 28 Hz = 4. Magar jab do awazon ki frequencies ka farq 10 Hz se zyada ho to beats pehchanna mushkil ho jata hai. Beats se piano ya violin jaisa taar wala saaz tune kiya ja sakta hai, maloom frequency ke note ke muqable note baja kar; phir taar ko kas kar ya dheela kar ke matlooba frequency par laya jata hai jab tak beats sunai dena band na ho jayein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Awaz longitudinal hai: hawa ki tehein lehar ki simt mein aage peeche hilti hain, is liye compression aur rarefaction bante hain. Roshni transverse hai: crest aur trough. Kitab longitudinal lehar ka Amplitude khara (vertical) teer bana kar dikhati hai; asal mein tehein lehar ki simt mein hilti hain, is liye yahan Amplitude ko lehar ki simt mein chhote do-teer se dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Beat frequency
blocks.text: Do waves ki frequencies ke farq ko beat frequency f_beat kehte hain. Agar do lagataar buland awazon ka waqfa T = t2 - t1 ho to f_beat = 1/T.

items: Guitar: thori mukhtalif tuning ke do taar bajane se beats bante hain, maslan standard tune kiya taar aur chand cents oopar ya neeche tune kiya taar.
Piano: do padosi keys, safed aur kaali, bajane se beats bante hain.
Violin: thore mukhtalif bow ke dabao ya raftar se do taar bajane se beats bante hain.
Drums: thori mukhtalif tuning ke do drums ek saath bajane se beats bante hain.
Flute: honton aur chehre ke patthon (embouchure) ki thori mukhtalif positions se do notes bajane se beats bante hain.
Organ: thori mukhtalif tuning ke do pipes bajane se beats bante hain.
Synthesizer: thori mukhtalif frequencies ke do oscillators chalane se beats bante hain.

blocks.text: In tamam misalon mein do sound sources ki frequency ka thora farq amplitude mein wafqe wafqe izafa aur kami, yaani beat ya dhadkan ka asar, paida karta hai. Musician aksar jaan boojh kar beats istemal karte hain ta ke dilchasp rhythm ke asraat, banawat (texture), ya tanao aur sukoon ka ehsas paida karein; magar kuch sooraton mein beats na-pasandeeda hain aur tuning, pitch ya bajane ke andaz mein tabdeeli chahte hain. Zyada tar taar aur hawa wale saazon ki awaz un mein stationary waves banne se hai (Do You Know).

blocks.title: Example 7.7
blocks.text: Do tuning forks 3 Hz ki beat frequency par beats dikhate hain. Ek fork ki frequency 256 Hz hai; phir us ke ek daante (prong) par thora mom laga kar us ki frequency thori kam ki jati hai, aur ab dono forks 1 Hz ki beat frequency dikhate hain. Doosre fork ki frequency nikalein. Hal: f1 = 256 Hz, mom se pehle beat frequency 3 Hz, baad mein 1 Hz, f2 = ?. Chunke f1 - f2 = +/-n, f2 = f1 +/- n = 256 +/- 3, to f2 = 259 Hz ya 253 Hz. Agar 259 Hz durust hota to pehle fork par mom lagane se us ki frequency 256 Hz se kam (255, 254 Hz) hoti aur beats 3 se zyada hote. Chunke pehle fork par mom lagane se beats kam hote hain, 259 Hz durust frequency nahi; lihaza f2 = 253 Hz, kyunke 254 - 253 = 1 Hz. 1711 mein shahi trumpet nawaz aur lute nawaz F. J. Shore ne tuning forks ijad kiye.

blocks.prompt: Tuning fork A fork B ke saath fi second 4 beats paida karta hai; B par mom lagane se beat frequency 6 ho jati hai. Agar A 320 Hz ho to mom lage B ki frequency nikalein (numerical 7.3). Frequency ka farq 10 Hz se zyada hone par beats pehchanna mushkil kyun hai (constructed response 7.5)?
blocks.explanation: B = 320 +/- 4 = 324 ya 316 Hz. Mom B ko kam karta hai; beats 6 tak sirf tab barhte hain jab B A se neeche ho, to B = 316 Hz aur mom lage B = 320 - 6 = 314 Hz. Fi second taqreeban 10 utaar charhao se zyada par kaan bulandi ke alag uthne girne ka peecha nahi kar sakta, to beats ek khurdari ya do-surili awaz mein mil jate hain; maslan 300 Hz aur 320 Hz ke notes fi second 20 beats dete hain, jo dhadkan ki bajaye khurdarapan sunai dete hain.

items: Beats: ek simt mein thori mukhtalif frequency ki do waves wafqe wafqe buland aur dheemi awaz deti hain; fi second beats = fA - fB (32 - 28 = 4); f_beat = 1/T; 10 Hz se oopar sunna mushkil. Guitar, piano, violin, drums, flute, organ, synthesizer tune karne mein istemal.
Example 7.7: forks 256 Hz aur 3 beats; mom se 1 beat, to doosra fork 253 Hz (259 Hz zyada beats deta).
